proposals.title: FIRST STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association and model-legislation memberships, and oversight processes.
proposals.evidence: We recommend a vote against the first stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: SECOND STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.proponent: Scott M. Stringer, Comptroller of the City of New York, on behalf of the New York City Employees' Retirement System, the New York City Police Pension Fund, and the New York City Board of Education Retirement System
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual public disclosure of EEO-1 workforce data broken down by race and gender across ten employment categories.
proposals.evidence: We recommend a vote against the second stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: THIRD STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.proponent: Scott M. Stringer, Comptroller of the City of New York, on behalf of the New York City Fire Department Pension Fund and the New York City Teachers' Retirement System
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board adopt a proxy access bylaw allowing shareholder-nominated director candidates to appear in company proxy materials under specified ownership thresholds.
proposals.evidence: We recommend a vote against the third stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: FOURTH STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.proponent: Investor Voice, on behalf of the Seattle Mennonite Church and Peter Feichtmeir
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending governing documents so non-binding shareholder proposals are decided by a simple majority of votes cast for and against, excluding abstentions.
proposals.evidence: We recommend a vote against the fourth stockholder proposal.
